hooks.name: Enforce Project Conventions
hooks.description: Before writing or editing any file, ensures the agent reviews conventions from steering files (naming, architecture, patterns).

action.prompt: Before writing this file, verify: 1) Naming follows conventions.md (PascalCase classes, _camelCase fields, etc.) 2) File is in the correct layer per architecture.md (Domain has zero infra deps, Application defines interfaces) 3) CQRS naming: Commands={Verb}{Entity}Command, Queries=Get{Entity}Query 4) One class per file, file name matches class name 5) Use file-scoped namespaces and primary constructors where appropriate 6) DTOs use records, entities inherit BaseEntity 7) No data annotations on entities (use Fluent API configs)
